name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI coding assistant integrated with GitHub and editors

pricing.notes: Official GitHub Copilot plan docs checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $10/month, with usage-credit changes in 2026.

verdictSummary: You can use open-source editor agents and local/API models, but Copilot's value is editor integration, model routing, GitHub context, completions, and managed usage.
coreLoopDIY: Install an open-source IDE assistant, connect model APIs or a local model, index the repo, and generate code/edit suggestions.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because low-latency completion and repo-aware coding are available in their editor without setup.

priorArt.name: Continue
priorArt.desc: Open-source coding assistant extension that connects to local or hosted models.

notes: Very relevant to the site's own audience; verdict is nuanced because the app is partly wrapper, partly platform.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for GitHub Copilot (AI coding assistant integrated with GitHub and editors). Requirements:

- Core loop: Install an open-source IDE assistant, connect model APIs or a local model, index the repo, and generate code/edit suggestions.
- Needs: VS Code/JetBrains extension.
- Needs: LLM API or local model.
- Needs: repo indexing.
- Needs: optional GitHub token.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: native GitHub/IDE integration; fast completions; model routing.
